stacking_order_note: CSMS #69606660 entry-summary sequence: Ch.98 → Ch.99 additional (Section 338 9903.03.12–.16) → trade remedies (301 → 122 slot inactive → 232 → 201) → replacement/MTB → other quota → Ch.1–97. Where China 301 (9903.88.xx or 9903.91.xx) and 232 both apply, 301 reports first among trade remedies.

rules.rule: Section 232 (autos/parts, vehicles, MHDV, metals, wood, semiconductors, patented pharma) and 301-FL are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. 232 wins. When 232 applies, report 9903.05.90 to suppress 301-FL.
rules.dependency: Valid 232 determination: auto-parts annex, passenger-vehicle list, MHDV vehicle/bus list or claimed MHDV part, wood HTS list, claimed semiconductor Note 39(b), metals chapter/claim, or patented-pharma claim. Chapter-level match is triage only for auto-parts.

rules.rule: China 301 — legacy 9903.88.xx (U.S. note 20) and four-year review 9903.91.xx / 9903.92.10 (U.S. note 31, 89 FR 76581 / CSMS #62411889) — is NOT suppressed by 232. Both report; 301 first. Note 31 replaces 9903.88.xx on the same HTS (do not stack both 301 headings). Worked example: CN 8708 List 3 at 2.5% col-1 = 25% + 25% + 2.5% = 52.5%. CN 7601.10.30 note 31(b) = 9903.91.01 25% + 9903.82.02 50% metal-content + 2.6% col-1. Also stacks with Sec 122 when the line is outside the 232 universe. Continues alongside 301-FL in the FL era (232 universe still reports 9903.05.90).

Brazil Section 301 country action (9903.05.01 @ 25%, eff. 2026-07-22) is distinct from 301-FL Brazil (9903.05.27 @ 12.5%, eff. 2026-07-24). Both stack when neither is exempt (91 FR 45516 note — additional duties in the subchapter still apply). 232 universe uses Brazil 301 exemption 9903.05.07 and still suppresses 301-FL via 9903.05.90 (R1).
Section 122 (9903.03.01) does NOT stack with Section 232 autos/parts or 232 metals. When 232 applies, report 9903.03.06 and suppress 9903.03.01. China 301 still reports (R2).
rules.source: Sec 122 proclamation 232 carve-out; Cervó / TRE stack examples; CSMS metals guidance

rules.rule: Section 232 automobiles are origin-driven. Default (most COO): vehicles 9903.94.01 @ 25% additional and parts 9903.94.05 @ 25% additional (Column 1 stacks). Japan (from 2025-09-16): vehicles 9903.94.41 / .40 and parts 9903.94.43 / .42. EU (from 2025-08-01): vehicles 9903.94.51 / .50 and parts 9903.94.53 / .52. Korea (from 2025-11-01): vehicles 9903.94.61 / .60 and parts 9903.94.63 / .62. When Column 1 is under the cap (15% JP/EU/KR; 10% UK parts 9903.94.32), CSMS default reports the cap on Ch.99 and $0 on Ch.1–97. Validated: JP 8703.23.01 @ 2.5% col-1 → 9903.94.41, total 15.0%. JP part @ 2.5% → 9903.94.43, total 15.0%. Same JP part NOT a 232 auto part → 9903.05.49 +10% → 12.5%.
232 metals duty reported on a separate entry line against metal-content value. Excluded from the parts TOTAL column.
232 metals vs 232 autos precedence on Ch.73/74 derivatives: CONFLICTING published guidance (one source: auto parts exclude steel/alu 232; another: they stack).

Leftover trade-deal flags (trade_deal_eu / trade_deal_kr / trade_deal_tw) and headings 9903.94.45/.55: MFN 'capped/removed' mechanic still UNRESOLVED — block totals. JP/EU/KR CSMS origin-split 232 headings are computed under R3 and are not this rule.
rules.blocking: Total-duty computation for all trade-deal lines

rules.rule: USMCA (SPI S/S+) and CAFTA-DR preferential claims suppress Column-1 (Chapters 1–97) duty and the Merchandise Processing Fee (MPF). Declaring S/S+ does NOT automatically suppress any other tariff program (301-FL, Section 232, China 301, Brazil 301, Section 338, Sec 122, etc.). Those programs are cleared only when their own USMCA / FTA / Note 52 Chapter 99 exception heading is applicable and claimed (e.g. 301-FL Note 52(g)/(h) via 9903.05.93 CA / 9903.05.94 MX). Section 338 has no SPI exemption.
rules.source: Jason Measures — USMCA / SPI claim scope; CSMS #69326983 Note 52

rules.rule: Section 338 Canada (9903.03.12–.14 @ 50%) stacks on Column 1, 301-FL, China 301, 201, AD/CVD, and MPF/HMF. USMCA/SPI zeros Column 1 only — it does NOT exempt 338. Mutually exclusive with 232 metals/autos/wood/MHDV/semiconductors/patented pharma via 9903.03.15 (0%). Civil aircraft 9903.03.16 (0%) requires civil_aircraft_gn6. Evaluate 232-family first, then gate 338. Drawback eligible. Suspended 2026-08-19 through 2026-08-21; live from 12:01 a.m. EST 2026-08-22. CSMS Ch.98/drawback text citing 9903.04.12–.14 is a CBP typo for 03.12–.14.

9903.94.xx family program labeling: 2026-07-27 session = Section 232 autos family; 2026-07-30 corrections = IEEPA/trade-deal. IEEPA was struck down 2026-02-20, so the label carries legal-basis and refund/drawback implications.
HTS classification authority: Item Master ONLY for parts (BL10 HTS is inaccurate). HA30 primary_tariff_num valid for vehicles with Item Master fallback.
45 lines carry active AD/CVD flags in the ACE table — require producer/exporter-level case coverage verification. AD/CVD is outside the Ch.99 stack computation.
